scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:python" "npm run dev:node" --names py,node --prefix-colors blue,magenta
scripts.dev:python: cd backend && uv run uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.install:all: cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && uv sync
scripts.lint:python: cd backend && uv run ruff check .
scripts.lint: npm run lint:python && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:integration
